block.title: The unchecked-IR middle-end optimizer runs in pure Gallina
block.p: The entire unchecked-IR middle end now lives in nine pure, zero-axiom Gallina modules under nanofil/rocq/opt, porting provenance.pl, promote.pl, copy.pl, alias.pl, local_storage.pl, simplify.pl, inline.pl, and opt.pl. Each pass reuses the backend CFG, escape, promotion, and copy primitives while transporting context/2 provenance records, retiring reused temporary spellings into history/5, and converting legacy loc/2 markers.

The extracted OCaml driver main.ml exposes standalone opt, alias, and valid-contexts commands over IR text parsed by IrText.v, as well as -O, --inline=none|small|wide, --simplify=none|full, and --pass= flags on cc-ir, pp-cc-ir, cc-asm, and pp-cc-asm. Wide inlining consumes the always_inline and noinline attribute list emitted by CLower.v directly, and nanofil-frontend -O --inline=wide --simplify=full --allocated pp-cc-asm compiles optimized C source straight to Fil-C x86-64 assembly without Prolog.

Differential testing against SWI-Prolog produces zero byte diffs across every suite: all 40 .ir fixtures across 13 single-pass and full-pipeline configurations (520/520) plus alias (40/40) and valid-contexts (40/40), all 276 optimizer calls and 2 alias_facts calls captured from the 160-test unit.pl suite, and all 329 preprocessed C units under nanofil/tests/ across five optimization modes (1,645/1,645 exact matches with full context/2 provenance). On swa, compiling, assembling with GNU as, linking with filcc, and running the resulting zero-Prolog -O binaries matched filcc -O1 on 177 standalone C programs under tests/c/prog/. Placing the optimizer in Gallina prepares the passes for direct refinement proofs against Semantics.v.

claim.p: The extended nanofil-frontend Nix check passes all nine differential suites including opt (645/645 exact across 13 passes and levels on all 40 .ir fixtures, alias, valid-contexts, and optimized cc-ir), and all 28 .v files across rocq/opt and rocq/frontend pass parse.sh.

Across the 329 lowered preprocessed C units on swa (reducing 6,295 IR items to 5,555), the middle-end optimizer delta drops from 32.6 s in SWI-Prolog to 3.9 s in extracted Gallina-OCaml, and total preprocess-to-optimized-IR wall time drops from 156.7 s to 40.3 s.

metrics.baseline: SWI-Prolog -O --inline=wide --simplify=full on 329 preprocessed C units (swa, single process)
